regions.region: title, abstract, DOI and article metadata
regions.finding: Article identity confirmed; abstract describes geometry-, enantio- and diastereoselective hydroalkylation and acidic hydrolysis.
Clayden et al. intramolecular N→C migration is cited prior work; stored as source_context, not this-paper experiment.
This-work generic intermolecular hydroalkylation of alkynes or allenes; one generic-scheme record with R/Ar templates.

unresolved: Generic R and Ar groups do not define concrete molecules.
ESI availability is stated but no SI file was explicitly supplied or associated.

regions.finding: Eight distinct optimization experiments transcribed with base loading, temperature, solvent exception, 48 h exception, isolated/NMR yields, dr and er.
Thirty-five substrate-scope experiments transcribed individually with isolated yield, dr and reported er/not-determined state.
Halogen, naphthyl, thiophenyl, benzodioxole, polyfluoro, enyne and bis-alkyne observations linked as interpretation; no duplicate experiments created.

unresolved: Compact stereochemical drawings were not expanded into unverified complete SMILES.
Scheme 2 does not state an er measurement method; footnote-a entries explicitly have er not determined.

regions.finding: Seven arrows recorded: esterification, amidation, diastereomer-forming cyclization with two products, two methylations and two stereodivergent hydroalkylations.
Large-scale 3a preparation and microwave acidic hydrolysis to amino-acid 4a recorded as two experiments; 74% is explicitly an isolated yield in prose.
Hydrolysis products 4a–4e inventoried; 4a merged with the immediately preceding hydrolysis arrow, and 4b–4e retained as separate derivatizations.
Seven allene-scope experiments recorded; X-ray of 3ac stored as characterization context rather than a synthesis.

unresolved: Scheme 3(c) does not report full hydrolysis conditions or yield measurement basis for 4b–4e.
The source reuses/overlaps label 4a for the amino-acid product and the allene caption; these are separate molecule IDs.
Several Scheme 3 yields lack an explicit isolated/NMR basis, and Scheme 4 footnote-a er values were not determined.

regions.finding: Author-proposed pathway stored as proposed_mechanism; the LiHMDS/CD3OD deuteration control is a separate mechanistic experiment.
In situ IR experiment and n-BuLi control recorded separately; 1926, 1666 and 1712 cm−1 retained as source strings because cm−1 is not a supported structured unit.
Four deuterium-labeling experiments transcribed row by row with x/y site-specific D incorporation; entry 4 includes the D2O quench.
No-alkylated-product control recorded without inventing a product identity or bond classification.
DFT transition states and relative energies stored as computational source_context, not synthetic experiments.

unresolved: The prose does not unambiguously assign the 65% D quench result to the n-BuLi versus LiHMDS IR mixture; it is recorded once with the Figure 1(a) LiHMDS sequence and flagged.
Main text does not state the measurement method for Figure 1(c) x/y percentages.
Transient intermediates and DFT structures are not isolated molecular identities.

regions.region: conclusion, author contributions, conflicts and acknowledgements
regions.finding: No additional reaction arrow; conclusion repeats the method scope without creating duplicate records.
HMPA and [12]crown-4 lithium-chelation controls recorded separately with reported ee values of 73% and 51%.
Bibliographic citations are context only; no cited-paper synthesis was imported as this work.

unresolved: Footnote 13 does not report additive loading, reaction yield, time/temperature or ee measurement method.
Reference 20 points to ESI details, but SI was not supplied.
